# Sound design for AI video: voiceover, SFX, music and a measured mix

**A script becomes a cue sheet, auditioned AI voices, sound effects on the frame, a music bed and a mix checked for LUFS.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_e6d4c33ff5cc.webp" alt="A designed launch soundtrack shown as a waveform and spectrogram with labelled voice, impact and music regions while a playhead moves across." width="480"></p>

Make the sound of any video so it feels real: AI voices that don't sound fake (cast from candidates a person picks, directed with each model's documented tags), dialogue and narration written for the ear with pauses, breaths and small actions, sound effects on the right frame, music planned bar by bar with a quiet part, and a measured mix. Built from 480 sourced findings (Walter Murch, Randy Thom, Ben Burtt, trailer editors, NPR, voice directors, model docs, HyperFrames, earshot) plus paid tests. An agent can't hear, so every step writes numbers: a cue sheet, scripts that build and grade the mix (LUFS, true peak, voice over music, effects within a frame, cuts on the beat, dead air), a voice audition page and an audio LLM judge that shortlists takes. Use for "add sound", "voiceover", "sound design", "music for my video", "make the AI voice sound real", "pick the best take", "SFX", "mix", "launch video audio", "trailer sound", in HyperFrames, Remotion or AI films. Not for making a song as the product.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill video-sound                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills video-sound --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Add voiceover, music and sound effects to my 45-second launch video in ./film and mix it to -14 LUFS"
- "The AI narrator sounds fake; audition 4 voices on the two hardest lines in lines.md and let me pick"
- "Plan the sound for a 30-second trailer: where the hits go, one silence, music bar by bar"
